name: OpenCode
_notes: Migrated from the legacy manifest's tui.* blocks (spinner 'esc interrupt' /
'[■⬝]{2,}' footer bar, settledPrompt 'Ask anything', modal question pattern),
then live-verified against opencode 1.18.15 rendered through ghostty-vt on
2026-08-17 (idle/busy/completion cycle + startup_dismiss config; see
fixtures/replay). The legacy manifest carries NO modal buttonPattern, so the
Live measurement: at the session-host 80x24 viewport the composer sits at
from_bottom ~16 (tips + path footer render BELOW it), so status_tail is
from_bottom 18 — a from_bottom 8 tail misses both the settled cue and the
'esc interrupt' spinner hint and wedges busy→idle.
approval extract.buttons added 2026-09-25 from a live capture (opencode
1.18.31, ghostty-vt render, fixtures/opencode-approval-bash-2026-09-25.txt):
the permission row is 'Allow once   Allow always   Reject' — three plain
labels on ONE line, no on-screen numbers or per-button key hints. Focus is
shown ONLY by an ANSI background-color repaint (verified via raw PTY bytes:
the focused cell gets \x1b[48;5;215m, others \x1b[48;5;234m) and the real
terminal cursor is hidden the whole time (\x1b[?25l) — formatPlainText, the
only render path the FSM evaluator reads, carries neither signal. So a
cursor_marker/select_mode:'arrow_keys' rule (the mechanism claude-cli/grok/
antigravity use) cannot locate the focused button here: fsm-driver.ts's
arrow_keys path deliberately REFUSES to press when no row reads `current`
(MESHAPPROVE-STALE-MODAL guard) rather than fabricate a cursor origin, and
that refusal is correct — there is no live signal to fabricate FROM. The
'Always allow' second-confirm modal (fixtures/opencode-always-allow-scope-
widen-2026-09-25.txt, buttons 'Confirm'/'Cancel') has the identical shape.
extract.buttons below therefore uses label_group ordinal extraction with NO
select_mode/key_group: it makes the button LABELS visible to the dashboard
and to approval-gate.ts's hasNegativeApprovalOption/hasReliableApprovalAffirmative
signature checks (both already pass live, see fsm-evaluator-opencode.test.ts),
but auto-press stays unwired on purpose — the only universally safe,
position-independent key verified live is Escape, which DISMISSES the modal
(declines) regardless of focus; there is no equally safe affirmative press
without a real focus signal. Live-verified 2026-09-25: fresh renders of both
modals always default focus to their FIRST (leftmost) button — confirmed on
4 independent captures including an 18s idle dwell before Enter — but this
single-instance fact is not the general 'current' contract arrow_keys mode
requires (a later click_modal_button call is not guaranteed to be the first
keystroke since the modal appeared), so it is documented here rather than
encoded as a press rule. Revisit if a future engine change teaches the FSM
evaluator to read ANSI attribute spans (formatVT) instead of plain text.
requiresFinalAssistantBeforeIdle keeps completion floored on the native
sqlite transcript exactly as the legacy path did.
Post-turn live capture: 'Ask anything' placeholder disappears after
the first turn (composer renders as empty accent-bar lines), so the
idle cue is the composer bottom frame '╹▀…' + spinner absence, NOT the
placeholder text (which only gates startup→idle).

source.session_query: SELECT id FROM session WHERE (@workspace = '' OR directory = @workspace) AND time_updated >= (@floor - 2) * 1000 ORDER BY time_updated DESC LIMIT 1
source.message_query: SELECT json_extract(m.data, '$.role') AS role, group_concat(CASE WHEN json_extract(p.data, '$.type') = 'text' THEN json_extract(p.data, '$.text') ELSE NULL END, '') AS content, (SELECT directory FROM session WHERE id = m.session_id) AS workspace, m.time_created AS timestamp_ms FROM message m JOIN part p ON p.message_id = m.id WHERE m.session_id = ? AND json_extract(p.data, '$.type') IN ('text', 'reasoning') GROUP BY m.id HAVING content IS NOT NULL AND content != '' ORDER BY m.time_created
